tests.title: inbox and exact presentation: the question, choices and rationale as the receipt holds them
ranked inbox: most urgent deadline first, then risk, with how soon each is due and an urgency lamp
inline answer: bound to the presentation shown, settled once, and Telegram after it settles nothing
answered in Telegram first: the UI answer is refused as already settled, beside the action
stale answer: the presentation changed after it was shown, and the answer is refused beside the action
snapshot binding: a refresh that brings a new version never changes what is being answered
answer as a member outside the project's scope: refused as out of scope beside the action
a member the request was not presented to: the answer is refused by name beside the action
the answer needs a choice and a rationale before anything is sent
every screen and state at 360px, light and dark
every screen and state at 390px, light and dark
every screen and state at 1280px, light and dark
every screen and state at 1440px, light and dark
phone decisions: the inline answer action is visible, unclipped and works at 360px
keyboard only on desktop: sign in, open a decision and answer it without a pointer
touch on phone: open a run and a decision from the bottom bar and answer by tapping
served assets: every response is this origin and every asset is a file of the build
phone terminal: the record gets the screen, with the strip on one line and the controls in one bar
desktop decisions: the most urgent decision is open, and the list scrolls on its own
full detail: an ended run shows every kept line, tool calls, output, edits and errors
live: lines appear as the worker prints them, and a dropped connection resumes from its cursor
follow mode: scrolling up stops following; jumping to the latest resumes it
station strip: the unit is lit at its station beside the record
run header: the run's state, elapsed time, engine and model, host and station, with the dispatch id as a copyable detail
compact gutter: each line's sequence, its time since the first line and an inline kind tag on the content's row
enroll-then-sign-in: a fresh passkey signs in only after the host approves it
unauthenticated access: no screen shows factory data before a passkey session
a session that ends while a screen is open shows the named refusal and drops the data
a member outside a project sees its named refusal and none of its data
route trace: every request each screen makes is a published API route or a built asset
